description: This file contains unit tests for the LoanDelinquencyDomainService class within the delinquency package of the Fineract portfolio module. It tests various scenarios related to calculating delinquency data for loans, including overdue calculations, chargebacks, installment-level delinquency, and handling pause periods.

classes.name: LoanDelinquencyDomainServiceTest
classes.description: Contains JUnit test methods for the LoanDelinquencyDomainService, testing scenarios related to overdue delinquency calculations, chargebacks, installment-level delinquency, and pause periods.

methods.name: givenLoanAccountWithoutOverdueThenCalculateDelinquentData
methods.description: Tests delinquency data calculation when the loan account has no overdue installment.

methods.name: givenLoanAccountWithOverdueThenCalculateDelinquentData
methods.description: Tests delinquency data calculation when the loan account has overdue installment(s).

methods.name: givenLoanAccountWithoutOverdueWithChargebackThenCalculateDelinquentData
methods.description: Tests delinquency calculation with chargebacks present, ensuring overdue days reflect chargeback effects.

methods.name: givenLoanInstallmentWithOverdueEnableInstallmentDelinquencyThenCalculateDelinquentData
methods.description: Tests delinquency calculation when installment-level delinquency is enabled, including installment-specific data.

methods.name: givenLoanInstallmentWithoutOverdueWithChargebackAndEnableInstallmentDelinquencyThenCalculateDelinquentData
methods.description: Tests calculation when chargebacks and installment-level delinquency are enabled, verifying number of overdue days and amounts.

methods.name: givenPausePeriodThenInstallmentDelinquentDaysOnlyIncludeOverlap
methods.description: Tests that delinquency days correctly account for pause periods, including partial overlaps across multiple installments.

methods.name: givenMultipleInstallmentsAndPauseThenDelinquencyDaysDistributePerInstallment
methods.description: Verifies that delinquency days are distributed correctly among multiple installments considering a pause period.
